purpose: Non-authorizing human review checklist. Not executable deployment approval.
evidence_policy: No raw tokens, personal transcripts, passwords or secret material. Require independent reviewer per gate.

gates.required: Approved hosted OIDC issuer/client and signed-token verification
Production-equivalent cookie/CSRF/proxy and browser security evidence
Approved new-session ownership model, tenant RLS, isolated migration and rollback
Legally approved consent purpose/version, recipients, retention and withdrawal effects
Real visitor-owned opt-in, withdrawal audit and revocation propagation
Independent hosted staging identity, storage, security and privacy acceptance
Rights, QA, settlement, sandbox financial and executive commercial release

current_behavior.consent_post: HTTP 409 for otherwise valid authenticated commands
current_behavior.synthetic_tests: Cannot establish real identity, user consent, or commercial authority

operator_note: Any future change of gate status requires non-secret evidence URL, independent reviewer and explicit decision. This manifest by itself must never be loaded as a feature flag or authorization source.
